description: This file defines core data models and game logic for a 2048 puzzle game, including classes for tiles, board state, move and merge steps, and static methods for starting new games and applying moves.

classes.name: Tile
classes.description: Immutable representation of a game tile with position and value.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: Immutable representation of the game board, managing tile placement, retrieval, and game state checks.

classes.name: MoveStep
classes.description: Data structure capturing a move from one cell to another for a specific tile.

classes.name: MergeStep
classes.description: Data structure representing a tile merge at a specific location.

classes.name: MoveResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of applying a move, including new board state, move details, score gained, and status flags.

methods.name: newGame
methods.description: Creates a new game board with two randomly placed tiles, primarily for starting a new game session.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Applies a move in a specified direction to the board, returning a detailed result including updated state and move actions.
